overview_description.description: Trukkin is a logistics technology company focused on digital freight and transportation management services. The platform connects businesses with transport providers for road cargo movement and supply chain operations. It offers tools for shipment tracking, fleet coordination, and logistics workflow management. The company primarily serves commercial transportation and freight distribution needs across regional markets.

product.name: Trukkin Technology Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform connecting shippers, transporters, brokers, and drivers to facilitate freight and cargo transportation locally and across borders.

product.name: Transportation Services
product.description: Physical freight and cargo transportation services across GCC and Middle East countries using a network of trucks and drivers.

product.name: Trukkin Mobile and Web Applications
product.description: Applications for shippers, transporters, brokers, and drivers to manage shipments, track vehicles in real time, and handle payments.

product.name: Insurance Plans
product.description: Country-specific insurance plans for cargo, trucks, health checkups, and related logistics needs.

product.name: Trukkin Adda Network
product.description: A networking platform connecting shippers, transporters, and drivers to facilitate collaboration and business growth.
